title: PCSO’s Nov. 16 lotto results: P373.62M jackpot not won
summary: MANILA, Philippines — No ticket holder won the P373.62 million Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot or the P22.33 million MegaLotto 6/45 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws on…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No ticket holder won the P373.62 million Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot or the P22.33 million MegaLotto 6/45 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws on Monday, Nov. 16, 2026. The Grand Lotto 6/55 winning combination was 11-43-32-26-52-09, with a jackpot prize of P373.62 million. No ticket matched all six numbers.
